formula: s=sum(w*w,axis1); q=normalize(A@s). Initialize QR([q,top31 energy columns of A]); existing32-wide power Z=QR(A.T Q),Y=A Z; final Q=QR([q,Y[:,1:]]), B=Q.T A. Zero-y uses unchanged parent factorization.
scope: 14 hidden plus one terminal star factor; fixed32 directions, one power step, existing D3 routes and consumer arithmetic. Terminal uses its actual selected output-weight columns.
rationale: Contains A@s in exact arithmetic, targeting squared-weight aggregate consumer. Not an optimal weighted SVD or full-tensor exactness claim. Existing additive residual native16 small positive was statistically inconclusive; this is a distinct fixed-rank reallocation hypothesis.
screen: Own N2 raw <= -0.1%, adjusted <= -0.1%, at least1 adjusted win, max regression <=1%, finite16/L0 exact; then existing boundary/N8 gates. No rank/layer/scale/seed sweep or rescue.
